messages:
alex: Heads up — FinText onboarding call next Wed. They pushed back hard on our token ceilings and want a softer trial/onramp (30% burst for 30 days). Need a quick decision on quota grace period and retro-credit rules.

maria: We previously agreed on a default 5% overage buffer, but partners asking for way more during ramp is reasonable for volume customers.

dillon: Practically we can offer a 2-week soft grace where usage > quota doesn't immediately bill, but we need precise limits: max overage tokens, rate-limit bursts, and no SLA during grace.

samir: Operational risk: caching/gaming + cost exposure. Propose a "grace credit bank" equal to 10–20% of monthly commit (usable only during first 30 days) and a telemetry flag to mark onramp accounts. Also require billing metadata for audit.

kelsey: From sales: FinText will only sign if they get a clear grandfathering rule for pilots and ability to apply credits retroactively to the first invoice. They're OK with no SLA but want contractual exit triggers and usage transparency.

pricing-bot: FYI: finance policy: any credit/adjustment > $10k requires RevOps approval workflow.

alex: Sounds like a path. Proposed terms: 14-day soft buffer + 20% token bank for onramp pilots. Retro credits allowed up to the first invoice; anything beyond routed to RevOps. Implementation items: UI toggle, billing metadata `billing.onramp_grace=true`, console banner, and a RevOps runbook. Launch criteria: docs + legal clause + RevOps signoff + product flag.

maria: Add guardrails: per-tenant burst limit (eg. tokens/minute) and a hard monthly overage cap (eg. 30% of committed tokens). Auto-rollback to capped tier if thresholds exceeded more than 3 days.

dillon: Rollout plan: canary on 5 partner tenants -> 48h telemetry window (spend, token distribution, errors) -> open beta -> GA. Infra ETA for canary: 2 weeks if we prioritize.

samir: I'll own telemetry + eval sets to detect burst patterns and potential abuse. Need an event `onramp.overage_detected` plus a nightly job to reconcile credits.

kelsey: I'll draft customer-facing messaging + contract language for pilots and send to sales by EOD Thursday.

alex: Great. Action items: Alex — RFC + legal tag; Samir — telemetry & reconciliation job; Dillon — infra rate-limits & UI flag; Kelsey — messaging + contract draft. Anyone else to loop in?

maria: Loop in @pricing-bot and RevOps once RFC ready. Also cc legal on the exit triggers.

alex: :thumbsup: Creating RFC now. We'll reconvene after canary metrics.
